title: Kommunalt bibliotek
request: Accurately identified actual Finnish municipal library, with source identity and license recorded.

title: Böcker, tidningar och studier
request: Actual library interior showing a source-listed use, not a fabricated event.

title: Öppet och kostnadsfritt
request: Distinct welcoming public library entrance/interior; no unverified current opening hours.

title: Sagor och spel för barn
request: Children’s books or board games in a verified library context; no unverified event schedule.

title: Läsesal
request: Actual library reading room with accurate source identity.

title: Tyst läxläsning
request: Distinct quiet study desk/reading setting, no photographed person identified as a pupil.

title: Datorhandledning och språkcafé
request: Verified actual library computer-guidance or language-learning setting; do not relabel an unrelated event.

title: Vetenskaps- och specialbibliotek
request: Actual university/research library accurately identified as such.

title: Oftast öppet för alla
request: Qualified access to research/special libraries; do not imply universal unrestricted access.

title: Bibliotekskort
request: Anonymous real example library card with no private name/barcode exposed, otherwise an original clearly schematic card.

title: Kort på biblioteket
request: Person requests a library card at a library desk; no invented registration conditions.

title: ID med bild
request: Generic anonymous photo ID illustration, not a usable official identity document or real personal data.

title: Tidsbegränsat kort
request: No Finnish personal identity code and time-limited card, without inventing the validity period.

title: Avgiftsfritt kort
request: Library card without initial charge, no invented sums.

title: Borttappat kort
request: Lost card and replacement fee, without inventing an amount or exceptions.

title: Bokbuss
request: Verified actual Finnish mobile library vehicle, not an ordinary bus.

title: Vanligtvis en månad
request: Exact source usual one-month book loan interval; no universal deadline asserted.

title: Returnera eller förnya
request: Two distinct source options before the due date, no invented renewal limit.

title: Förseningsavgift
request: Overdue book and fee icon, no invented rate or amount.

title: Böcker och dagar påverkar avgiften
request: Book count and elapsed overdue days feed the fee calculation without fabricated values.

title: Lättläst finska
request: Verified easy-Finnish/selkokieli book example or clearly source-based open-book illustration; no fabricated published cover.

title: Finska studier
request: Distinct Finnish-language study material, accurately identified and licensed.

title: Olika material
request: Actual books, magazines, optical media or e-reader showing source examples; no copyrighted page reproduction beyond needed object view.

title: Kostnadsfria tjänster
request: Public library services and no client charge, no unsupported claim that overdue/replacement fees are waived.

title: Över 80 språk
request: Books and language symbols with the exact source over80 count; no invented language inventory or assertion that a random branch is the Multilingual Library.

title: Låna i hela Finland
request: Source-stated national lending reach; no invented delivery time, routes or map boundaries.

title: Barn- och ungdomsböcker
request: Actual Finnish library children/youth collection, no unverified inventory count.

title: Barnets eget kort
request: Guardian permission linked to the child’s library card; no invented age threshold.
